title: Third-Party Certification for Customs Clearance
summary: This thread tracks the evolution of mandatory certification requirements for customs clearance, shifting from general pre-shipment inspection (PSI) agencies to specific industry-based associations and government departments. Over time, the procedure has moved from broad PSI-based verification to highly specific, sector-dependent certifications required for duty exemptions or regulatory compliance.

evolution.authority: From independent PSI agencies to industry associations and finally to government departments and commercial banks.
evolution.scope: From general valuation/quality checks to specific usage verification and compliance with annual import entitlements.

timeline.change: Formalized the requirement for importers to obtain certification from inspection agencies for CIF value verification.
Shifted certification authority to specific industry associations (Leather/Tanners) for specific import consignments.
Introduced government department-level certification (Energy Division) for specialized industrial equipment.
Expanded certification requirements to include dual-verification from local customs offices and commercial banks for bonded warehouse imports.
